title: Subscription
body:
The app is designed very well and looks really good, but that would be all if we’re talking about good sides of it. 

Unfortunately, the notifications wouldn’t work and occur on my phone, as i checked everything the issue wouldn’t disappear. 

But that wasn’t big problem, the REAL problem was being fooled by developer. I knew I was purchasing an app with a 7days free trial, and then (as was clearly written before I downloaded the app) I would have pay around 2$ monthly. I thought “well okay, 2$ is alright) but then suddenly around 25$ was taken from my bank account. I was charged for a ONE YEAR subscription and i wasn’t even informed about it. It might have been written somewhere, but it surely is just fooling people so they pay huge amount of money for the app. 

I had to contact the Apple Help Service, because I was really shocked and scared because of having NO MONEY left on my bank account. I’m glad they helped me, and downloading your app was a big lesson for me - I will check everything ten times before I purchase any other application (Productive - habit tracker was first non-free app on my phone). 

If someone have a lot of money then I even might reccomend this app - but to me, it is way to pricey and not fair for the customers to make them pay for one year without clearly telling them that.
